dataset: OpenBookQA-V1-Sep2018 Additional (Mihaylov et al., 2018), Apache-2.0 -- train+dev+test, each question annotated with its gold core fact fact1

examples.fact: as the population of plants decreases , carbon in the atmosphere will increase
thick feathers can be used for keeping warm
the circulatory system carries oxygen from the digestive and respiratory systems to the rest of the body
as heat increases , a flexible container containing gas will expand
arctic animals live in an arctic environment

note: For each Additional question, the gold answer is the choice whose label == answerKey and the gold fact is fact1. 'gold in fact' = the normalized gold text is a non-empty substring of the normalized fact; the same test is applied to each distractor. gold_coverage_rate = questions with gold-in-fact / valid questions; distractor_coverage_rate = distractor-in-fact hits / total distractors (option count controlled). Text is lowercased and whitespace-collapsed only (punctuation kept), so the leak counts are a conservative lower bound. n_fact_eq_a_choice counts verbatim fact==choice matches. Rows whose answerKey matches no choice label are malformed and excluded.
